Semiconductors are becoming critical to the global economy, and India is investing heavily to reduce its import dependence and build a domestic semiconductor ecosystem. With billions in government support and fresh investments from Indian and global companies, can India become a global semiconductor hub?
In this video, we explore:
PART 1: How the global semiconductor supply chain works and which countries dominate it.
PART 2: India’s semiconductor push, government initiatives, major investments and companies building capabilities across the value chain.
